exercises.title: C Major Steps
exercises.subtitle: Original exercise 01 / even pulse and adjacent notes
exercises.instruction: Keep an even pulse; connect each step without rushing.

exercises.title: Three-Beat Arc
exercises.subtitle: Original exercise 02 / phrasing in three
exercises.instruction: Feel one strong beat, then two lighter beats in every bar.

exercises.title: Open Sky Arpeggios
exercises.subtitle: Original exercise 03 / wider intervals and upper register
exercises.instruction: Prepare each leap calmly; let the final high C ring for four beats.
